notes: Non-animated highlighted Pierre only. Streamdown, memory and footprint were not rerun.
Primary results use three fresh-browser replays per build/scale, commit-paced 40ms deliveries, no tracing or DOM sampling during playback.

Baseline 1000x run 1 is retained as raw data but excluded from primary medians: preparation of a later bundle briefly overlapped that run. A final quiet control replay of the exact frozen baseline bundle replaces it.
The repeated delta matrix predates the exceptional-hook recovery guard; none-top-final independently checks the final guarded renderer and reproduces the gain.
Only the delta contract is library behavior. Containment and ResizeObserver scroll variants are benchmark-only diagnostics.
Grouped sections change wrapper structure and intrinsic-height estimates; matching normalized content does not prove equivalent layout or selection.
